title: Membership
description: Who may borrow: a librarian registers a person as a member, and the member's ID goes on their card.

title: Catalog
description: What can be lent: librarians add tools to the catalog, take a damaged tool out of lending, and put it back once it is repaired.

title: Lending
description: Loans themselves: a member borrows a tool for the loan period, and a librarian takes it back and records its condition.
